text:
For your one-hour morning commute, I recommend "The New York Times Book Review Podcast" or "99% Invisible" (if you enjoy the design of books as well as the content). "The New York Times Book Review Podcast" features in-depth interviews with authors and critics, offering the deep literary analysis you miss from your reading time. It is perfectly paced for a 60-minute train ride, providing substantial content without being overwhelming. Another excellent option is "Literary Friction," which explores the intersection of literature, culture, and politics through long-form conversations with writers.

The drink that comes from cows is milk.
